title: FBI Photo B15
doc_notes: This document is an FBI report to AARO containing a still image of a UAP, noting that the timestamp on the image is incorrect due to a system error.

incidents.summary: A grainy monochrome image captured by a U.S. military system showing two small, dark, circular objects near a central crosshair.
incidents.explanation: The operator reported that they were unable to positively identify the UAP.
incidents.quote: Two small, dark, circular objects are visible near the center of the frame in the upper right quadrant.
